item.title: US Initial Jobless Claims Below 200,000 for Third Straight Week
item.content:encoded: Applications for US unemployment benefits edged up to 199,000 in the week ended Aug. 1, according to Labor Department data released Thursday. Claims remained below 200,000 for a third straight week and the four-week moving average fell to the lowest since September 2022. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Scotiabank's Warrier on Hedge Funds' Tough July
item.content:encoded: Mithra Warrier, managing director and global head of financing sales at Scotiabank, joined the program to provide insights as the market approached the close. The discussion highlighted a difficult July for hedge funds, referencing performance data from major firms such as Verition, Balysansy, Schonfeld Partners, Millennium, Point72, and Coatue. The segment focused on the factors contributing to the tough month for these funds and the broader implications for investors and market participants. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Tech Stocks Propel Markets to Record Highs
item.content:encoded: Noel Dixon of State Street highlights the continued upside potential in tech stocks, suggesting there is still room for increased exposure and near-term momentum that could lead to further gains. The conversation also previews upcoming insights from Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co, who will address investor concerns related to SpaceX's aggressive spending plans, and Ashok Bhatia of Neuberger, who will discuss why markets may be underestimating the pace of disinflation. Overall, the segment underscores investor confidence despite some jitters around AI developments and corporate spending strategies. (Source: Bloomberg)
